string.text: Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Muffler mount
A special thread allows you to install a silencer on the weapon.
Rail fastening
Allows you to install various types of sights on weapons.
Tactical grip

Installing an under-barrel grip allows you to make the weapon more convenient to handle, making it easier to compensate for recoil.The kit includes replacing the forend with a tactical one, which allows you to install additional equipment on the weapon due to the presence of Weaver mounts.
Laser pointer

Visually indicates the location of the intended hit on the target, greatly facilitating and speeding up aiming, as well as having a demoralizing effect on the victim.Does not interfere with the installation of a tactical flashlight and can be used in conjunction with it.
Tactical flashlight

A narrow-beam, long-range flashlight is indispensable for night forays, as well as when exploring unlit areas.Does not interfere with the installation of a laser pointer and can be used in conjunction with it.
Improved backplate
Allows you to reduce the recoil felt by the shooter from a shot from a weapon.
Modification of the cartridge supply unit
Individual fitting of the power supply parts allows you to reduce the likelihood of delays during shooting associated with non-feeding and misalignment of the cartridge.
Forcing USM
Refinement of the firing mechanism components makes it possible to increase the weapon's rate of fire, unfortunately, at the cost of some reduction in reliability.
USM calibration
Individual fitting and balancing of standard parts of the firing mechanism allows for higher shooting accuracy while reducing recoil.
Re-rifling the barrel
Increases the initial speed of the bullet, due to which the bullet deviates less from the expected trajectory and reaches the target faster.Useful for long range shooting.
Recoil compensator
The muzzle compensator allows you to reduce the recoil felt from the weapon by redirecting the flow of powder gases.
Shutter Balancing
Balancing the bolt group parts reduces the barrel moving away from the aiming line and the spread of bullets when fired.
Heavy Duty Parts
Replacing standard parts with analogues made of high-strength alloys and coating weapon mechanisms with a special protective compound can increase its wear resistance.
Improved extractor
Refinement of the spent cartridge ejection unit makes it possible to reduce the number of delays that occur during shooting due to the stuck cartridge case.
Light alloy parts
Replacing standard parts with analogues made of light alloys significantly reduces the weight of the weapon.
